t: When you will not get justice in this life
a: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
p: Rabbanā innaka jāmiʿu-n-nāsi li-yawmin lā rayba fīh, inna-llāha lā yukhlifu-l-mīʿād.
m: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in His promise."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
